import requests

API_KEY = "YOUR_API_KEY"  # replace with your actual API key from the provider
BASE_URL = "https://api.the-odds-api.com/v4/sports"  # example provider; check their docs

def list_sports():
    url = f"{BASE_URL}/"
    params = {"apiKey": API_KEY}
    resp = requests.get(url, params=params, timeout=10)
    resp.raise_for_status()
    return resp.json()

def get_upcoming_odds(sport_key="soccer_epl", region="uk", markets="h2h", date_format="iso"):
    # sport_key depends on the API (e.g., "soccer_epl", "basketball_nba")
    url = f"{BASE_URL}/{sport_key}/odds"
    params = {
        "apiKey": API_KEY,
        "regions": region,
        "markets": markets,
        "oddsFormat": "decimal",
        "dateFormat": date_format
    }
    resp = requests.get(url, params=params, timeout=10)
    resp.raise_for_status()
    return resp.json()

def print_sample_odds():

    except requests.HTTPError as e:
        print("Failed to fetch odds:", e)

if __name__ == "__main__":
